Definition: from G5192; "hyacinthine" or "jacinthine", i.e. deep blue:--jacinth.
BiblicalUsage: The word hyakínthinos carries the sense of jacinth-coloured, deep blue. In Revelation 9:17, the text says "and of jacinth."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hyakínthinos I do not force more than it gives: jacinth-coloured, deep blue.
